# Feature Requirements Checklist: Import Bank Transactions

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the feature requirements.
**Created**: 2026-11-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [X] CHK001 - Are Family creation, owner-only access, multiple account creation, and currency selection/editing requirements complete and aligned? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-004, §FR-019, §FR-030]
- [X] CHK002 - Are all supported CSV column-mapping patterns, regardless of source column order or header names, specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005–FR-007, §FR-020]
- [X] CHK003 - Are all required fields and the destination account, currency, row count, and interpreted row values covered by the review requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-010]
- [X] CHK004 - Are account-scoped access, transaction access, import-review access, and explicit exclusions for Family members and access grants specified consistently? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, §FR-030, Assumptions]
- [X] CHK005 - Are administrator settings, defaults, runtime changes, and non-administrator restrictions all covered by requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, §FR-029, User Story 4]

## Requirement Clarity

- [X] CHK006 - Are date-format confirmation, signed-amount sign convention, and distinct direction-value mappings defined without overlap? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006–FR-007, §FR-020]
- [X] CHK007 - Are amount sign, zero, separate-column, precision, and currency-indicator rules unambiguous for each mapping pattern? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-011, §FR-018, Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK008 - Are the expected currency amount formats, ambiguous-format handling, mismatch prompts, and wrong-account outcome clear for currencies beyond the AUD example? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, §FR-021–FR-022, Assumptions]
- [X] CHK009 - Are identifier-matching boundaries clear for digit sequences, spaces or punctuation, BSBs, card numbers, labels, and longer sequences? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013–FR-014, Assumptions]
- [X] CHK010 - Are the exact fields and precision of the last-successful-import timestamp clear, including UTC storage and viewer-localized display? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [X] CHK011 - Are the rate-limit window, attempted-request counting rules, and boundary behavior specified, including whether rejected attempts count? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026, §FR-029, Data Model §Import settings, §Import rate window]

## Requirement Consistency

- [X] CHK012 - Do review requirements for valid rows align with whole-import rejection requirements when any row is invalid? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010–FR-012, Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK013 - Are privacy rules consistent across validation, reviews, errors, diagnostics, audit events, and unmapped source data? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014–FR-015, §FR-027, Data Model §Import review]
- [X] CHK014 - Are duplicate matching, account scope, same-file matches, warnings, and explicit import/cancel choices consistent across requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016–FR-017, User Story 3]
- [X] CHK015 - Do Family ownership requirements align with the no-members/no-grants scope and the owner's access to every Family account? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, §FR-030, Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [X] CHK016 - Can the account creation and import usability targets be measured consistently from the participant, task, and timing definitions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-002]
- [X] CHK017 - Are the 100% data-integrity, identifier-rejection, unchanged-state, and duplicate-detection outcomes tied to clearly defined acceptance populations? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003–SC-005]
- [X] CHK018 - Are incoming/outgoing comprehension, WCAG 2.2 AA, and regional-format success criteria objectively evaluable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006–SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [X] CHK019 - Are primary, alternate, rejection, cancellation, and recovery requirements complete for each supported import format? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, §FR-006–FR-012]
- [X] CHK020 - Are concurrent imports, stale transaction lists, and duplicate checks across accounts and within one file addressed as distinct scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, §FR-023, User Story 3]
- [X] CHK021 - Are administrator and ordinary-user scenarios both covered for viewing, changing, and enforcing shared limits? [Coverage, Spec §FR-026, §FR-029, User Story 4]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [X] CHK022 - Are empty, unreadable, malformed, non-CSV, no-row, quoted-field, embedded-delimiter, and embedded-line-break cases addressed in requirements? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK023 - Are ambiguous or inconsistent dates, missing mappings, empty fields, invalid amounts, conflicting currency indicators, and invalid direction values covered? [Coverage, Edge Cases, Spec §FR-011, §FR-020–FR-022]
- [X] CHK024 - Are review expiry, failed confirmation, lease release, staged-row deletion, and cleanup timing sufficiently specified for terminal and interrupted imports? [Gap, Data Model §Import review, §Import review row; Spec §FR-012, §FR-023]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [X] CHK025 - Are accessibility and theme requirements complete for account and import flows, including system preference changes and the absence of a saved override? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028, §SC-007]
- [X] CHK026 - Are file-size, row-count, and request-rate bounds measurable, and are exceeded-limit outcomes clear without exposing file contents? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-026, §FR-029, User Story 4]
- [X] CHK027 - Is the inheritance of application availability and recovery targets explicit, and is the absence of a feature-specific latency target intentional? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [X] CHK028 - Are the currency reference, currency-format conventions, and user responsibility for selecting source columns documented as dependencies or assumptions? [Dependency, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Research §Currency and regional formats]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [X] CHK030 - Is the meaning of “up-to-date transaction list” defined well enough to determine when an import may proceed and which transaction state duplicate checks use? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-023, User Story 3]
- [X] CHK031 - Are rejected-row visibility and actionable-error requirements reconciled with the rule that sensitive values must not appear in reviews, errors, or diagnostics? [Conflict, Spec §FR-011, §FR-014–FR-015, Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK032 - Are the allowed audit outcomes and the required distinction between started, succeeded, cancelled, expired, and failed imports defined consistently? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-027, Data Model §Import audit event]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline; link to relevant resources or documentation.
